mapper.sql: rescue_id, animal_id, publish_user, rescue_content, location, order_status, deal_user, result, create_time, urgency

when.test: orderStatus == "救助中" or orderStatus == "处理中"

choose.when: AND order_status IN ('救助中', '处理中')

mapper.select: SELECT FROM rescue_order WHERE rescue_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rescue_order (animal_id, publish_user, rescue_content, location, order_status, deal_user, result, create_time, urgency) VALUES (#{animalId}, #{publishUser}, #{rescueContent}, #{location}, #{orderStatus}, #{dealUser}, #{result}, #{createTime}, #{urgency})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rescue_order WHERE order_status = #{value}

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.nickname, u.username, COUNT(*) AS count FROM rescue_order r JOIN `user` u ON r.deal_user = u.user_id WHERE r.order_status = '已完成' GROUP BY u.user_id, u.nickname, u.username ORDER BY count DESC, u.user_id LIMIT #{limit}
